title: The Borrow Checker
content:
# The Borrow Checker

The borrow checker is a component of the Rust compiler that enforces the rules of ownership and borrowing. It prevents:

- Use after free
- Double free
- Data races
- Dangling pointers

It ensures these errors are caught at compile time, leading to safer code without runtime overhead.
